correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the canonical torus-pushforward measure: with b=s/2, the Shilov-boundary image obeys |a|²+|b|²=1; an explicit lift of every interior point via orthogonal v and |a|<|v|<sqrt(1-|b|²) proves the projected open ball. Haar phases give radial |a|²~Beta(1/2,1/2) and independent uniform coordinate phases, hence dν=dσ/(π|z1z2|) and orthogonal moments (1/2)_k(1/2)_ell/(k+ell)!. The kernel is the Appell F2 series for this two-coordinate subspace only. Shift weights squared are (k+1/2)/(n+1),(ell+1/2)/(n+1), sum exactly 1. The diagonal self-commutator equals 1/[2(ell+1)] at k=0 and (ell+1/2)/[n(n+1)] at k>=1, so positive compact. Regular eigenvalue shell count n*(1-epsilon*(n+1))_+ +O(1) with exceptional O(epsilon^-1) yields N(epsilon)=1/(6epsilon²)+O(epsilon^-1), Schatten iff q>2, logarithmic Dixmier trace of C²=1/6. Fresh rational moments and counts at 1/10,1/100,1/1000 corroborate but do not prove the asymptotic.
